meta.subject: RASTER_UNIT: Fix for non-power of 2 window size issue

en.summary: Fixes raster window clipping by converting the stored quad location back to pixel coordinates before comparing against destination width and height.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly identifies a non-power-of-two raster window-size fix.
The patch changes DUT quad mask generation in VX_raster_qe.sv.
The changed arithmetic directly corrects the coordinate system used by the in-bounds test.
evidence: The bounds check changes from x_loc_r + i / y_loc_r + j to ((x_loc_r >> 1) + i) / ((y_loc_r >> 1) + j).
The earlier temporary workaround had disabled the check entirely, and this commit reintroduces it with corrected arithmetic.
The previously added UNUSED markers are removed because the coordinate and dimension signals are needed again.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A quad evaluator may store the quad origin in doubled, tile-relative, or otherwise scaled units, while the framebuffer bounds are expressed in pixels. The boundary clip test must convert the stored origin back to pixel coordinates before applying per-sample offsets. If it does not, edge quads are clipped using the wrong coordinate system and valid samples disappear.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Quads near the framebuffer boundary when the evaluator stores origin coordinates in a scaled domain rather than directly in pixels.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Compare the stored scaled coordinates directly against pixel-space width and height, without converting them back to pixel coordinates first.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: remove coordinate down-conversion before bounds check
portability_notes: This maps to any raster/tile pipeline where a 2x2 or block origin is tracked in a domain different from final pixel coordinates.
The bug is most visible on boundary quads because interior samples still satisfy either comparison.
If the target DUT uses multiplication or concatenation instead of a shift, reintroduce the equivalent wrong-domain comparison rather than the exact syntax used here.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the boundary predicate that gates the per-sample output mask.
Remove the conversion from stored quad origin to pixel origin before applying the sample offset.
Leave the sample offset and edge-function tests unchanged so the regression is specifically a bounds-check bug.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Quad evaluator bounds check around mask and barycentric updates
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix restores the boundary check and changes it to `((x_loc_r >> 1) + i) < dst_width && ((y_loc_r >> 1) + j) < dst_height`.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Change the guard back to `(x_loc_r + i) < dst_width && (y_loc_r + j) < dst_height` so the shift-right conversion is removed.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Boundary quads produce incorrect masks and drop valid samples, especially near the right and bottom edges of the render target.
evidence_for_injection: The fix is localized to one arithmetic expression in the mask-generation block.
The follow-up from the earlier workaround makes the intended coordinate conversion explicit via `>> 1`.
No surrounding flow control or storage structures are changed, so the bug is directly attributable to the bounds-check arithmetic.
notes: This is the proper root-cause fix; unlike dataset item 295, it does not simply disable clipping.

zh.summary: 该提交通过先把保存的 quad 位置转换回像素坐标，再与目标宽高比较，修复了 raster 窗口裁剪错误。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确指出这是 non-power-of-two raster window-size 的修复。
补丁修改的是 VX_raster_qe.sv 中 DUT 的 quad mask 生成逻辑。
被修改的算术表达式直接修正了 in-bounds 测试所使用的坐标系。
evidence: 边界检查从 x_loc_r + i / y_loc_r + j 改为 ((x_loc_r >> 1) + i) / ((y_loc_r >> 1) + j)。
之前的临时 workaround 是直接关闭该检查，而本提交重新引入了它并修正了算术。
此前为绕过问题而加入的 UNUSED 标记也被删除，因为这些坐标和尺寸信号重新参与了正确计算。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: quad evaluator 可能以双倍坐标、tile 相对坐标或其他缩放后的单位保存 quad 原点，而 framebuffer 边界则处于像素坐标域。边界裁剪测试在施加每个 sample 的偏移前，必须先把保存的原点换算回像素坐标。否则就会在错误的坐标系里裁剪边缘 quad，导致合法 sample 消失。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 边缘裁剪中的坐标域转换
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: quad 靠近 framebuffer 边界，且 evaluator 内部保存的原点坐标不是直接的像素坐标时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在与像素空间的宽高比较时，直接使用保存的缩放坐标，而不先转换回像素坐标。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 删除边界检查前的坐标降尺度转换
portability_notes: 可映射到任何在最终像素坐标之外，还维护 2x2 或块级原点坐标的 raster/tile 流水线。
该 bug 在边界 quad 上最明显，因为内部 sample 即使用错坐标也往往仍满足比较。
如果目标 DUT 不是用右移实现换算，而是用乘法或拼接，则应恢复等价的错误坐标域比较，而不是拘泥于这里的具体语法。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位控制每个 sample 输出 mask 的边界谓词。
去掉从保存的 quad 原点到像素原点的转换，然后再加上 sample 偏移参与比较。
保持 sample 偏移和 edge-function 测试不变，使回归专门体现在 bounds-check 上。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 围绕 mask 与 barycentric 更新的 quad evaluator 边界检查
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复恢复了边界检查，并将其改为 `((x_loc_r >> 1) + i) < dst_width && ((y_loc_r >> 1) + j) < dst_height`。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把守卫条件改回 `(x_loc_r + i) < dst_width && (y_loc_r + j) < dst_height`，去掉右移转换。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 边界 quad 会产生错误的 mask，并错误丢弃本应保留的 sample，尤其在渲染目标的右边界和下边界附近。
evidence_for_injection: 修复被局部化为 mask 生成块中的一个算术表达式。
相对于之前的 workaround，这个提交用 `>> 1` 明确表达了期望的坐标转换。
周围的流控或存储结构都没有变化，因此问题可以直接归因于边界检查算术。
notes: 这是根因层面的正式修复；与数据项 295 不同，它不是简单地关闭裁剪逻辑。
